gaps.explanation: Proprietary fund statement p6 (printed p10) has Enterprise Fund and Debt Service Fund columns; detail[] has only the utility funds combining schedule p10 (printed p19: Electric, Water, Sewer, Sanitary Landfill, Meter Deposits = the Enterprise Fund). Debt Service Fund column nonoperating revenues: Interest Income 92 and Miscellaneous Income 6 (Total 565 = 473 + 92; 15,837 = 15,831 + 6). Schedule 1,048,093 + 92 + 6 = 1,048,191 = statement. The Debt Service Fund column also prints Transfers In From Enterprise Fund 104,750 and Transfers Out To Enterprise Fund (85,000); there is no business-type transfers gap row, so they are added here (section other financing, not part of the revenue arithmetic): with them detail transfers net 22,581 (Enterprise, existing line) + 104,750 - 85,000 = 42,331 = the p6 Total column net transfers.
